title: Operational Concealment of Measurement Incompatibility by Quantum Channels: Rank Loss versus Contraction
summary: Quantum measurements can remain incompatible yet become impossible to certify when all probe states first pass through a quantum channel. We formulate this loss of certifiability as operational concealment and identify its exact finite-dimensional threshold. Under tomographically complete input access, a channel conceals some incompatible binary POVM pair if and only if its Heisenberg adjoint has nontrivial kernel.
